sentences.en: The report argued for enhanced equity of access and better funding for childcare and early childhood education institutions.

sentences.en: Unquestionably, that’s a real need; but since parents don’t normally send children to pre-schools until the age of three, are we missing out on the most important years of all?
sentences.zh: 无疑,这是真正的需要;但是,由于父母通常不会送孩子上学到三岁,我们是否错过了最重要的几年?

sentences.en: B A 13-year study of early childhood development at Harvard University has shown that, by the age of three, most children have the potential to understand about 1000 words – most of the language they will use in ordinary conversation for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的13年幼儿发展研究显示,到了三岁,大多数儿童有可能理解大约1000个字,大多数语言是他们在普通对话中将终生使用的语言。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Furthermore, research has shown that while every child is born with a natural curiosity, it can be suppressed dramatically during the second and third years of life.
sentences.zh: 此外,研究表明,每个孩子出生时都有着自然好奇心,但在出生的第二和第三年,儿童可能会受到极大压制。

sentences.en: Researchers claim that the human personality is formed during the first two years of life, and during the first three years children learn the basic skills they will use in all their later learning both at home and at school.
sentences.zh: 研究人员声称,人的个性是在生命的头两年形成的,在头三年,儿童学习他们在以后的家中和学校学习时将使用的基本技能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Once over the age of three, children continue to expand on existing knowledge of the world.

sentences.en: C It is generally acknowledged that young people from poorer socio-economic backgrounds tend to do less well in our education system.
sentences.zh: C. 人们普遍承认,来自较贫穷社会经济背景的青年人在我们的教育系统中往往表现较差。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That’s observed not just in New Zealand, but also in Australia, Britain and America.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In an attempt to overcome that educational under-achievement, a nationwide programme called ‘Headstart’ was launched in the United States in 1965.
sentences.zh: 为了克服教育成绩不佳的问题,1965年在美国发起了一个名为 " 头起 " 的全国方案。

sentences.en: A lot of money was poured into it.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It took children into pre-school institutions at the age of three and was supposed to help the children of poorer families succeed in school.
sentences.zh: 它让3岁的儿童进入学龄前机构,并本应帮助贫困家庭的儿童顺利上学。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: Despite substantial funding, results have been disappointing.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Many children who entered it at the age of three were already behind their peers in language and measurable intelligence.
sentences.zh: 许多在3岁时进入该学校的儿童已经在语言和可计量的智力方面落后于同龄人。

sentences.en: At the end of each day, ‘Headstart’ children returned to the same disadvantaged home environment.
sentences.zh: 每天结束时, " 头起重回 " 儿童回到同样的不利家庭环境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D As a result of the growing research evidence of the importance of the first three years of a child’s life and the disappointing results from ‘Headstart’, a pilot programme was launched in Missouri in the US that focused on parents as the child’s first teachers.
sentences.zh: D 在美国密苏里州启动了一个试点方案, 重点是家长是孩子的第一任教师。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The ‘Missouri’ programme was predicated on research showing that working with the family, rather than bypassing the parents, is the most effective way of helping children get off to the best possible start in life.
sentences.zh: `Missouri ' 方案基于一项研究表明,与家庭一起工作,而不是绕过父母,是帮助儿童走上人生最好开端的最有效方式。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The four-year pilot study included 380 families who were about to have their first child and who represented a cross-section of socio-economic status, age and family configurations.
sentences.zh: 为期四年的试点研究包括380个家庭,这些家庭即将生育第一个孩子,并代表着社会经济地位、年龄和家庭结构等方方面面。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They included single-parent and two-parent families, families in which both parents worked, and families with either the mother or father at home.
sentences.zh: 其中包括单亲家庭和双亲家庭、父母双方都工作的家庭以及家中有父母或母亲的家庭。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The programme involved trained parent-educators visiting the parents’ home and working with the parent, or parents, and the child.
sentences.zh: 该方案涉及经过培训的父母教育者访问父母家,与父母或父母以及儿童合作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Information on child development, and guidance on things to look for and expect as the child grows were provided, plus guidance in fostering the child’s intellectual, language, social and motor-skill development.
sentences.zh: 提供关于儿童发展的信息,指导儿童成长时寻找和期望的事情,以及指导儿童的知识、语言、社会和运动技能发展。

sentences.en: Periodic check-ups of the child’s educational and sensory development (hearing and vision) were made to detect possible handicaps that interfere with growth and development.
sentences.zh: 对儿童教育和感官发育(听力和视力)进行定期检查,以发现可能妨碍成长和发展的残疾。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: Medical problems were referred to professionals.

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Parent-educators made personal visits to homes and monthly group meetings were held with other new parents to share experience and discuss topics of interest.
sentences.zh: 家长教育者亲自访问家庭,并与其他新父母每月举行小组会议,交流经验和讨论感兴趣的议题。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Parent resource centres, located in school buildings, offered learning materials for families and facilitators for child care.
sentences.zh: 设在学校建筑内的家长资源中心为家庭和儿童保育促进者提供学习材料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E At the age of three, the children who had been involved in the ‘Missouri’ programme were evaluated alongside a cross-section of children selected from the same range of socio-economic backgrounds and family situations, and also a random sample of children that age.
sentences.zh: 在E,在3岁时,对参与`Missouri ' 方案的儿童进行了评估,同时对从社会经济背景和家庭状况相同的一系列情况中挑选出来的各类儿童进行了评估,并对年龄的儿童进行了随机抽样。

sentences.en: The results were phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 结果令人惊叹。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: By the age of three, the children in the programme were significantly more advanced in language development than their peers, had made greater strides in problem solving and other intellectual skills, and were further along in social development.
sentences.zh: 到3岁,该方案的儿童在语言发展方面比同龄人大得多,在解决问题和其他知识技能方面大有进步,在社会发展方面走得更远。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In fact, the average child on the programme was performing at the level of the top 15 to 20 per cent of their peers in such things as auditory comprehension, verbal ability and language ability.
sentences.zh: 事实上,该方案的平均孩子在听力理解、语言能力和语言能力等方面表现在其同龄人的前15%至20%的水平。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Most important of all, the traditional measures of ‘risk’, such as parents’ age and education, or whether they were a single parent, bore little or no relationship to the measures of achievement and language development.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是,传统的 " 风险 " 衡量标准,如父母的年龄和教育,或是否单亲,与成绩和语言发展衡量标准几乎没有或根本没有关系。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Children in the programme performed equally well regardless of socio-economic disadvantages.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Child abuse was virtually eliminated.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F These research findings are exciting.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There is growing evidence in New Zealand that children from poorer socio-economic backgrounds are arriving at school less well developed and that our school system tends to perpetuate that disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 新西兰有越来越多的证据表明,来自社会经济背景较贫困的儿童正在进入欠发达的学校,而且我们的学校系统往往使这种不利处境长期存在。

sentences.en: The initiative outlined above could break that cycle of disadvantage.

sentences.en: The concept of working with parents in their homes, or at their place of work, contrasts quite markedly with the report of the Early Childhood Care and Education Working Group.
sentences.zh: 与父母在家中或工作场所共事的概念与幼儿保育和教育工作组的报告形成相当明显的对照。

sentences.en: Their focus is on getting children and mothers access to childcare and institutionalized early childhood education.

sentences.en: Education from the age of three to five is undoubtedly vital, but without a similar focus on parent education and on the vital importance of the first three years, some evidence indicates that it will not be enough to overcome educational inequity.
sentences.zh: 从三岁到五岁的教育无疑至关重要,但是,如果不同样重视父母教育和前三年的极端重要性,一些证据表明,这不足以克服教育不平等。
